text:
Sofia R: Heads up - need an exception routing. Candidate for Staff ML Eng got auto-band 6 but hiring manager signed band 7. Candidate can start 2026-05-02 and is firm. Any fast-path for uplift?
Anita M: Drop comp numbers?
Sofia R: Base target $300k, band6 cap $260k. Manager ok with $300k plus $40k sign-on. Total ~340k.
Kyle G: Budget is in headcount but uplift > standard. We normally require comp committee approval + finance OK. Can we do provisional sign-on while committee reviews?
Finance Ops: Provisional sign-on possible but need documented approval chain and cost center confirmation. Also watch benefit enrollment cutoff (5/01).
Sofia R: Candidate insists on 5/02 due to relocation timing. Manager says losing candidate is high risk.
Anita M: Option: offer band6 base at max + one-time sign-on now, with conditional uplift to band7 after committee approval. Exec sponsor required.
CompCommitteeBot: Approval ticket created: AW-7890. Status: submitted -> committee review pending. Link: https://internal.redwood/aw/AW-7890
RecruiterBot: Candidate informed of provisional plan, willing to accept contingent offer if we secure exec sponsor.
Kyle G: I can escalate to VP Eng (R. Patel) for exec sponsor. Will ping now.
Anita M: Please add market comp justification and manager performance milestone (review at 3 months) in AW-7890.
Sofia R: Will upload market comps and manager note. Can committee review within 48h?
CompCommitteeBot: Reviewer assigned: H. Lopez. Target review ETA: 24h.
Kyle G: VP Eng replied: "open to provisional exec stamp pending committee vote."
Finance Ops: If committee approves uplift, we need PO update. Please include PO request in AW-7890. Procurement lead will need 2 business days.
Sofia R: Drafting offer. Provisional language suggestion: ```Offer AW-7890
Base: $300,000
Sign-on: $40,000 one-time
Band: provisional band7 pending committee approval
Start: 2026-05-02 onboarding / 2026-05-09 payroll
Note: payroll and benefits effective 2026-05-09; onboarding may begin earlier.```
Anita M: Add line: "If band uplift approved within 60 days, base will be adjusted retroactively to payroll start date."
Sofia R: Added. Uploading to AW-7890 now.
CompCommitteeBot: AW-7890 update: H. Lopez approved provisional uplift at 1742103360. Finance review requested.
Finance Ops: Reviewed. Funding approved contingent on PO 23-ML-4401. Sent to procurement for final sign-off.
Procurement Bot: PO 23-ML-4401 created, awaiting final sign-off.
Sofia R: Offer sent to candidate, candidate accepted verbally and confirmed start 2026-05-02 contingent on paperwork. Signed offer to follow. :white_check_mark:
Kyle G: Great - please confirm payroll enrollment once paperwork is received so benefits team can onboard on 5/09.
Sofia R: Will update once signed doc in. Thanks all.
RecruiterBot: AW-7890 closed pending signed offer and PO confirmation.
